content:
Essential Legal Short Forms Every Law Student & Advocate Should Know!

In the legal profession, understanding commonly used abbreviations makes court proceedings, case files, and legal drafting much easier.

I've created a simple handwritten chart covering court & judge terms, case filing abbreviations, criminal procedure, evidence & trial terms, order-sheet terminology, and drafting & filing terms.

A useful quick-reference guide for LLB students, interns, and aspiring advocates.
